decision: HAMCP-319 Phase 2 parity candidate for exact ha-mcp 9.1.0 (d2e3f4b0, official OCI images only). Standalone tools/list captured with the filesystem feature flag off (77 tools). The add-on catalog is treated as identical: with the flag on, the exact app and standalone catalogs were byte-identical (82 tools, aae387f7), and 9.1.0 publishes no _meta.ha_mcp.policy block; a flag-off add-on capture was not separately run. ha_get_hacs_info is unsupported (ledger row 15 hold, HAMCP-290); ha_get_operation_status stays held. Local candidate only; CI, independent review, installed admission, publication and version change are separate gates.
